items.title: DeepSeek shipped an experimental vision model
items.oneliner: DeepSeek added image input with 64 MiB Files API support, making multimodal workflows cheaper and easier to productionize.

items.title: AT&T is routing work to open models
items.oneliner: AT&T says 40% of employee AI traffic now hits open models, cutting coding costs 56% with a 2% quality drop.

items.title: Meta reported stronger multimodal agent evaluations
items.oneliner: Meta says Muse Spark improved multimodal and agentic evals, a reminder frontier competition is shifting beyond text benchmarks.

items.title: A Rust crate shipped build-time malware
items.oneliner: The compromised arrayref 0.3.10 pulled a typosquatted dependency that downloaded a remote binary during cargo build.

items.title: Agencies warned about AI-assisted ICS attacks
items.oneliner: CISA, FBI, and NSA warned AI is lowering the skill floor for attacks on Siemens S7 industrial controllers.

items.title: Phone deletion at the border became a felony case
items.oneliner: A US citizen faces felony charges for deleting phone data at the border, raising the stakes for device privacy.

items.title: GitHub detailed its August outage
items.oneliner: GitHub says its August 17 outage lasted 7 hours 47 minutes, exposing how fragile developer infrastructure still is.

items.title: Firecracker was rebuilt for Apple Silicon
items.oneliner: Encore recreated the Linux microVM stack on Apple Silicon, shrinking the gap between local Mac development and Linux production.

items.title: Micron announced a Boise AI memory hub
items.oneliner: Micron will spend $10 billion on a Boise research hub, signaling memory is becoming a first-class AI bottleneck.

items.title: TigerBeetle explained its performance architecture
items.oneliner: TigerBeetle argues kernel behavior and memory fragmentation matter more than query tuning when throughput and tail latency actually count.
